job.title: Temp Data Entry/Customer Service
job.description:
• Do you have solid customer service and order entry experience?
  • Are you happy to commit up until Christmas?
  • Can you work Monday - Friday 8.30am - 4.30pm or similar?

We are looking for a candidate with an excellent telephone manner who is experienced with customer service and data entry to assist our client during their peak season.

If you are able to start early October and can commit to working 8.30am - 4.30pm Monday to Friday up until the Christmas break we'd love to hear from you.

It is possible this role may recommence in January for an extra few weeks (though not confirmed at this stage)

SMEATON GRANGE area location. Own transport essential.

Don't delay, APPLY NOW!
